views.name: primitives
views.covers: every DebugDraw primitive in the default view, drawn after tone mapping: depth-tested lines hidden by and intersecting scene surfaces, always-on-top lines over them, and an alpha-blended circle

views.name: primitives_fsr1
views.covers: the same primitives with FSR 1 at its performance preset, so output-resolution lines test against scene depth rendered at a lower resolution
